   130	 PROPOSED COMPLIANCE ORDER
   131	Pursuant to 49 United States Code § 60118, the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
   132	Administration (PHMSA) proposes to issue to Tallgrass a Compliance Order incorporating the
   133	following remedial requirements to ensure the compliance of Tallgrass with the pipeline safety
   134	regulations:
   135	A.
   136	
   137	In regard to Item 1 of the Notice pertaining to not opportunistically gathering
   138	missing attributes when the pipeline was replaced, Tallgrass must find pipe
   139	removed during the relocation project and test it for the missing attributes. If
   140	Tallgrass cannot find the removed pipe, then it must mobilize to the line segment,
   141	excavate a remaining section of pipe that was missing TVC data, and get those
   142	attributes. Tallgrass must complete this requirement within 180 days of receipt of
   143	the Final Order. Within 30 days of completion, Tallgrass must send
   144	documentation to Gregory A. Ochs, OPS Central Region Director, PHMSA
   145	showing the Compliance Order requirement has been fulfilled.
   146	
   147	C.
   148	
   149	It is requested that Tallgrass maintain documentation of the safety improvement
   150	costs associated with fulfilling this Compliance Order and submit the total to
   151	Gregory A Ochs, Director, Central Region, Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
   152	Safety Administration. It is requested that these costs be reported in two
   153	categories: (1) total cost associated with preparation/revision of plans, procedures,
   154	studies and analyses, and (2) total cost associated with replacements, additions
   155	and other changes to pipeline infrastructure.
